## Topics
- What data science looks like in public health
- R, RStudio, and RStudio Projects
- Objects, functions, packages
- A first look at a real dataset

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Navigate RStudio and create an RStudio Project
- Run code in the console and in a Quarto document
- Install and load packages; use glimpse() to inspect a data frame

## Data
NHANES (`NHANES` package)
